timestamp.Description: Time elapsed since start of recording, disregarding any discontinuities if present (see participants.tsv)

ecg.Description: Lead II electrocardiogram measurement collected with ECG100C module

icg.Description: Thoracic impedance magnitude (Zo) collected with EBI100C module, with inner spot electrodes on jugular notch & xiphoid process and outer electrodes on spine

stethescope.Description: Heart sounds recorded using DA100C module and Biopac TSD108 contact microphone as stethescope, placed on Aortic auscultation area (right 2nd ICS)

trigger.Description: Voltage from LabJack U6 communicated event timing information from experiment control computer. Voltage was set to 1 during baseline periods, 2 during synchrony trials, and 3 during delay trials; set to 0 otherwise.
